_about: 카드별 그림 지시(영어). 카드 이름만으로 모습이 분명하지 않거나 꼭 들어가야 할 것이 있을 때 카드 ID로 적는다. 스페셜 · 유니크는 모두 적는다(새로 만들 때도). build_prompts.js가 프롬프트의 'Art direction' 줄로 넣는다.

_shot._about: v3.96 유니크 카드별 구도(그림 AI용 영어). camera = Camera 줄 전체, light = 원소 주광이 오는 쪽. 유니크끼리 · 다른 등급과 겹치지 않게 카메라 높이 · 거리 · 자리 · 빛 방향을 모두 다르게 둔다.

UN-A1.camera: tight intimate medium close-up at eye level, the demon in left profile on the right third of the frame, his blade held horizontally across the foreground as he writes on it; the crimson contract thread runs out to the left into darkness toward a tiny distant foe
UN-A1.light: from the glowing blood script on the blade below his face, lighting him from underneath

UN-A1-7.camera: steep bird's-eye view looking straight down on the hooded wraith standing in a dark field; the sweep of his scythe draws a great curved arc on the ground, pale souls rising toward the camera and turning into fluttering contract pages
UN-A1-7.light: from the rising souls below, a cold upward glow

UN-A2.camera: rear view from just behind her comrades, over their shoulders at eye level: the knight seen from behind in the centre-left, wings spread wide across the frame like a wall, a storm of arrows coming toward the camera and shattering on the feathers
UN-A2.light: from the incoming arrow storm and the battlefield ahead, silhouetting her wings with radiant edges

UN-A2-7.camera: wide establishing shot at eye level, the seraph priestess small on a ridge in the left third, the rising sun on the far horizon at right; between them a long slope where fallen knights rise in a line out of the morning mist
UN-A2-7.light: low raking dawn light from the far horizon, long shadows stretching toward the left edge

UN-A3.camera: dizzying high angle from above and behind the star-keeper on the needle-tower platform, looking down past her shoulder at the clouds and the tiny land far below; her half-drawn bow in the lower left, wind-borne star glyphs streaming past
UN-A3.light: from cold starlight overhead, falling straight down

UN-A3-7.camera: frozen-time side profile at eye level, very shallow depth: the arrowhead piercing a glowing enemy spell sharp in the left foreground, the night-elf archer soft and dark in the right background at the end of the light stream
UN-A3-7.light: from the pierced enemy spell in the foreground, lighting him from the front left

UN-B1.camera: canted Dutch angle, mid-shot at chest height: the old goblin captain tipping backward off a gun bastion, tilted diagonally across the frame, grinning, lit fuse raised; his cannons firing in a row behind him
UN-B1.light: from the muzzle flashes of the cannon battery, harsh orange flashes from the left

UN-B1-7.camera: close two-shot at table height of hands and face: the goblin gunner's hands in the foreground pressing a glowing ember into an open shell, his face just above, intent; through an embrasure behind, burning lines on the battlefield
UN-B1-7.light: from the ember in his hands, lighting his face from below and in front

UN-B2.camera: quiet eye-level close shot inside a workshop: the small new golem standing in the lower foreground, the old patched golem's huge careful hands framing it from both sides, his riveted face looking down at it in the upper right
UN-B2.light: from a single hanging lamp above, a warm pool of light

UN-B2-7.camera: dead-straight frontal shot at eye level from the enemy's position, flat and symmetrical: the two gate golems side by side filling the frame edge to edge like a wall, the steel chain stretched horizontally across them
UN-B2-7.light: from forge fire and lava channels directly behind them, edges glowing, faces in shadow

UN-B3.camera: view through the curved glass of a large empty jar in the foreground, the gnome researcher seen slightly distorted through it holding it up at eye level; around her, cracked jars on shelves filling with lightning
UN-B3.light: from the lightning crackling inside the jars around her, flickering from many sides

UN-B3-7.camera: extreme long shot from a high vantage, the walking tower small in the centre of a vast plain, a huge visible ring of orbiting coins, dice and metal debris around it, its magnetic field bending the air
UN-B3-7.light: from the lightning at the tower's crown, a storm-lit sky above

UN-G1.camera: long-lens telephoto shot at eye level straight down the line of the charge: the orc chief in the foreground, howling, mid-body crop, his warband compressed close behind him bursting out of the dust cloud
UN-G1.light: hard sidelight from the left through the dust, deep shadow on his right side

UN-G1-7.camera: three-quarter high angle looking down on the plunder-king seated still and at ease on a heap of captured weapons and banners, a calm throne-portrait
UN-G1-7.light: from braziers on the left, warm firelight across the heap

UN-G2.camera: close side profile at eye level, the old treant kneeling in the right half of the frame, its bark hands working among the briars; new thorns curling up from the roots in the foreground
UN-G2.light: from soft shafts falling through the canopy above

UN-G2-7.camera: side-on tracking shot at eye level, the old treant walking from right to left across the frame, seed pouches swinging from its branches; behind it to the right a young forest springs up along its path over the battlefield
UN-G2-7.light: from the low evening sun behind it at right, rim-lighting its branches

UN-G3.camera: high aerial view over the night sea, the singer small on a rock in the lower left, her song spreading as wide glowing rings across the water; pale souls riding the waves toward a shore at the upper right
UN-G3.light: from the glowing song rings on the water, lighting her from below

UN-G3-7.camera: over-the-shoulder shot from behind the siren on her rock in the right foreground, her back and hair to the camera, singing toward a distant shore at left where enemy soldiers turn their swords on themselves
UN-G3-7.light: from the moon low ahead of her, silhouetting her against the sea

_light._about: 카드별 'Light and colour' 줄 덮어쓰기(스페셜 짧은 틀). 색감만 바꿀 때 쓴다.
_light.SP-B2: Light and colour: a whole-image silver glow — cold silver-white light radiating from the heart is the main light and washes every surface; base metals are polished silver and white steel with mirror-bright cold silver-white highlights; palette silver, white steel, pale platinum, cool steel grey #a9b4c2 and deep gunmetal shadows against the very dark night-blue; the rune rings shine silver-white with only a thin gold edge; small accents only (under 10% of the light): a few ember-orange sparks in the deepest heart seams, a thin trace of crimson-rose (#ff4d73) and ether sky-blue (#8fdcff) sparks in the swirling smoke; no brass, copper or orange-dominant areas; the silver radiance is this grade's mark, not banner spellcasting.

SP-B1: A colossal being of living fire who swallowed the sleeping giant Dormak's heart-fire whole — one of a kind: a towering, majestic titan of cracked black basalt and flowing magma, taller than Fortan's chimneys and gun bastions, which look like toys at his feet. In his open chest Dormak's heart-fire blazes like a furnace sun behind ribs of cooling rock, and molten light pours from his eyes and mouth. One arm is raised and a cannon-blast of fire erupts from his palm — each breath he exhales is a whole battery's volley — while pillars of smoke and ash rise around his head like a crown. Tiny gunners kneel on the bastion walls below, lit by his glow, not daring to speak his name. Behind him the volcano-chest of the giant Dormak splits open across the whole sky. Terrible grandeur, not a monster.
SP-B2: The heart is the focus: an enormous iron heart forged from the giant Sorgrim's sinew-ore — polished silver and white-steel plates, bright silver valves and pistons like arteries, cold silver-white light pulsing through its seams with only a faint ember glow deep inside a few cracks — beating at the centre of the image, larger than a forge furnace. The one who swallowed it is a colossal armoured presence that is only partly seen: his vast shape is veiled in pale steam, shadow and silver-grey forge smoke and revealed only in glimpses — the edge of a riveted white-steel shoulder like a cliff, a giant gauntleted hand resting on an anvil the size of a house, two eyes glowing high above in the darkness. Hundreds of steel chains and pipes run from the heart up into the hidden body; let the viewer imagine the full titan from these clues. Around it stretches the underground forge-cathedral of Durkheim; rows of golems in silver-grey armour, tiny by comparison, kneel facing the heart, their own chest-lights waking in rhythm with its beat, the oldest and most patched golem kneeling closest. He ascended without any god: instead of a halo, slowly turning rings of silver gears and silver-white runes circle the heart. Composition (keep exactly as in the existing artwork): the giant heart floats at the upper centre wrapped in orbiting rune rings; the cliff-like shoulder and pipes on the left edge; the giant gauntlet resting on a house-sized anvil at the right; two eyes glowing at the top centre; the oldest golem kneeling seen from behind in the bottom centre foreground; rows of kneeling golems along the bottom; arched forge halls receding on the left; monumental low angle.
SP-B3: The Seventh: an automaton prototype that one day began to think. An elegant copper-and-glass body with seven glowing lightning nodes (no numerals), a lightning brain visible inside a glass dome head, one hand raised in wonder at a spark it made itself. Tiny scholars look up at it from its feet.
SP-G1: Karno Ashmane: a colossal duel-titan of living stone and ash, one of a kind. A towering warrior body of cracked dark granite and basalt with glowing ochre-orange magma seams, every one of his hundred duel scars a molten crack; a vast mane of grey ash and drifting embers streams from his head and shoulders like a volcanic plume (the 'ash mane'); fists like boulders bound in ancient leather straps; his face is a stern, noble mask of stone with burning eyes. He stands in a stone duel ring cracked into a crater, mid-stride and roaring a challenge, rock dust and embers exploding around his feet. Behind him the mountain-sized earth dragon Gorvath, forests on its back, lowers its great head to meet him eye to eye, as if for a hundred-and-first duel, while the standing stones and nomad camps of the Garun steppe lie tiny below and a trail of ash-grey smoke drifts across the plain behind him.
SP-G2: Lisiel Silvermoon, a walking forest that moves only on nights of the waxing moon — one of a kind: a tall being half figure and half tree, bark skin threaded with silver moonlit veins, branches for hair, ember-scarred bark with young green leaves regrowing from every scar, saplings sprouting wherever it steps. It once took a burning forest's fire into its own body and raised a thousand-year forest from the ashes in a single night. Silver moonlight mixed with green spore-light; the forest dragon Verdan's branch-antlers form a canopy above.
SP-G3: She Who Lulls the Sea: the oldest song remembered by the water dragon Marencia, given a body — one of a kind. A serene woman-shaped being whose body from the waist down and through her flowing hair is living, translucent water; her hands are joined as she sings, and her song spreads over the dark sea as glowing rings of light; a blade passing through her becomes only ripples. Far below, in the black trench, the faint glow of the sleeping giant Talakus's colossal heart slows to the rhythm of her song. Behind her the translucent serpentine body of Marencia coils through the sky like a river of light, forming a halo. Calm, sacred and vast.
SP-A1: Azra the Shadowless at the height of her ascension — a colossal, regal figure standing above the sunless canyon city of Noctar, so tall that its violet-lit spires reach only to her knees. Her great curved horns form a dark crown framed by a total eclipse that serves as her halo; a vast cloak of living night spills from her shoulders down the canyon walls like a waterfall of shadow. Every shadow in the city — of towers, bridges and kneeling figures — stretches and bends toward her like supplicants, yet she herself casts none: the ground beneath her feet is bright and bare, make the missing shadow unmistakable. Her face is serene and half-veiled by drifting shadow-silk, eyes glowing violet. A burning contract scroll floats beside her open hand, its blood seal glowing. Above her in the sky the faceless shadow king Morkas holds his scales, one pan weighed down by something veiled — what she gave. Calm, still, overwhelming power — not an action pose.
SP-A2: The First Knight of Solante, the first ever to swear an oath to the Mother of Dawn — a mythic champion: lifted by the goddess herself, vast wings of light bursting from his back, rising from one knee with his sword raised toward the dawn; where his blade is raised the night recoils and sunrise floods the sky. He is colossal: he kneels on the hills beyond the Dawn Citadel Elad, whose white walls and towers reach only to his knee, and the armies on its walls are tiny specks of light; each of his wings spans the whole horizon, and his face is lit high above the clouds.
SP-A3: Isaac who unravelled the stars, the first to read the star glyphs — a transcendent star-mage: he pulls threads of starlight down from the sky into an open book while a whole constellation unravels and re-weaves itself around him as abstract glyphs, and the sky obeys; silver hair and robes swept by star-wind. He is colossal: he stands among the clouds above Belumir's Needle, its tallest spires reaching only to his waist and tiny watchers on its lookout platforms looking up; the constellation he unravels covers the whole sky, and its threads of starlight fall into his book like rivers.
SR-A1: The greatsword of Hargan the Judge, drawn only once to punish a god: a colossal two-handed sword of dark adamant and gold, scales of judgment engraved on the blade, standing point-down in a cracked divine altar under a beam of judgment light.
SR-A2: The bow of Seren the Gatekeeper, who guards the edge of the world: a tall bow of pale silver and starlight, a nocked arrow of light drawn by no hand, aimed at a dark horizon where the world ends.
SR-A3: The quill of Ivel the Recorder: a great feather quill whose ink is ether light, writing glowing abstract strokes in the air that turn into tiny real scenes; an endless library fades behind it.
SR-B1: A furnace carved from one colossal rib bone of the sleeping giant Dormak: the curved ivory-black rib forms the body of a brazier, glowing heartfire roaring inside, flames leaping hungrily toward a burning ember on the ground, volcanic ash drifting.
SR-B2: The first armour of the sleeping giant Sorgrim: a huge breastplate made from a single giant rib segment fused with dark iron ore, resting upright on an iron anvil-altar as an incoming shadow-blade strikes it and bounces back in a shockwave of sparks, iron ridge mountains glimpsed through an opening behind.
SR-B3: A crackling heart fragment of the thunder giant Keraun, held in a brass-and-glass cage on a dark stone altar: the crystal heart pulses with branching blue lightning that arcs fiercely outward whenever a faint distant spell circle flares nearby.
SR-G1: The broken fang of the earth dragon Gorvath: a massive cracked stone-and-bone fang bound with hide cords on a stone altar (at most a single weathered hand reaching toward it), still stained, glowing amber veins pulsing as if it hungers, a tiny fallen beast silhouette in the distant haze.
SR-G2: The first antler of the forest dragon Verdan: a great branching antler of living wood resting on a mossy root altar, roots snaking from its base and drawing wisps of faint green life-light out of a thorned silhouette in the distant shadow, moss and leaves sprouting along its tines.
SR-G3: The chalice of the sea dragon Marencia's tears: a pearl-and-coral chalice on a sea-stone altar overflowing with luminous blue water, a gentle tide spilling from its rim toward a tiny wounded silhouette in the distant shadow, mist and soft light rising.
UN-B1: An old goblin artillery captain of Fortan with a long grey ear-tuft and a brass spyglass, commanding a battery of cannons; even while falling he grins and holds a lit fuse.
UN-B2: Bron's first golem: an old, patched, riveted golem carefully building a new small golem from the parts of fallen comrades with gentle hands.
UN-B3: The gnome researcher who once bottled the lightning spirit Zrak, holding the biggest empty jar while cracked empty jars around her refill with lightning.
UN-G1: The great chief of the Rockfang tribe: an enormous orc with a stone-fang necklace, howling as his warband charges out of the dust behind him.
UN-G2: An ancient treant keeper of thorns around the First Elder Tree; cut briars regrow from the roots all around him as he works.
UN-G3: A singer of the Spring Choir; her song spreads as glowing rings over the sea, and pale souls of the drowned ride the waves back toward the shore.
UN-A1: A demon writing his oath in his own blood with the edge of his blade; a crimson thread of the contract links his sword to his distant foe.
UN-A2: A radiant knight of Elad spreading her wings like a shield in front of her comrades, arrows breaking against the feathers.
UN-A3: A high-elf star-keeper archer on a lookout platform atop Belumir's Needle, bow half-drawn, reading abstract star glyphs carried on the wind before the enemy's spells arrive.
UN-B1-7: A goblin gunner planting embers scooped from Talakus's black blood-pulse into his shells; behind him the struck ground keeps burning in long lines.
UN-B2-7: Two huge gate golems of Durkheim bound together by one massive steel chain, moving as one wall.
UN-B3-7: A walking tower wound with Keraun's lightning; its magnetic field bends the air — coins, dice and metal debris spin in orbit around it.
UN-G1-7: An orc plunder-king wielding weapons he took from fallen foes, a heap of captured arms and banners at his feet.
UN-G2-7: An old treant with seed pouches hanging from his branches; wherever he walks after battle, a young forest springs up behind him.
UN-G3-7: A siren risen from Marencia's deep waters, singing on a rock; in the distance enemy soldiers turn their swords around against themselves.
UN-A1-7: A hooded wraith reaping souls with a great scythe; every soul he takes turns into a contract page fluttering into his hand.
UN-A2-7: A seraph priestess lifting the dawn light in both hands; fallen knights rise again behind her in the sunrise.
UN-A3-7: A night-elf spell-hunter archer: his arrow pierces a glowing enemy spell mid-air, and streams of foreign-coloured magic are pulled along the arrow into his bow and swallowed as light.
SG1-02: Finishing the staggering: a single deep ochre earth-tremor ripples outward across a rocky dusk battlefield as a glowing crack-line through the ground; wherever it passes under the reeling, already-wounded foes (small dark silhouettes in the distance) the earth heaves and they topple. The tremor line itself is the subject. Mood: cold, decisive, no barrier or shield.
SG1-08: Fang counterattack: a colossal spectral wolf-jaw of ochre earth-light and bone-white stone bursts up out of cracked rock and snaps shut on an enemy sword that has just struck — the fangs fill the centre of the frame, the blade shattering between them in a spray of sparks and dust, its glow draining away to a thin thread. Behind the jaw a low ring of warm ochre glow hardens the ground like stone hide. The fangs are the one subject. Feeling: wounded but defiant, the pack bites back.
MC-01: Crouching wolves: tall dry grass at ochre dusk, perfectly still, with only glinting amber eyes and the faint outline of fangs hidden low in it; a hush of ochre haze hangs over the grass, and across the field the enemy line (small dark silhouettes) hesitates, weapons lowered and wavering. Low eye-level, tense calm before the spring.
SG1-03: Cornered fang: a huge spectral wolf-maw of ochre earth-light lunges across the field in one sweep, tearing a sword out of the air, then a breastplate, the pieces spinning away, and its leftover momentum already bending toward the next target (small dark silhouette) behind. Motion-blurred fang light, dust, brutal frontal composition.
MG-13: Bone breaker: an empty, already torn-open suit of armour (broken plates and straps hanging off) is struck by a massive fist of rough stone and ochre earth-light coming in from the edge of the frame; at the point of impact sharp fractures of ochre light spread through the armour like breaking bone. Close, diagonal, brutal composition.
M2-1: An orc's tattooed fist: a huge grey-green orc fist, knuckles freshly tattooed with dark fang-shaped marks in ochre and black pigment, beside a bone tattoo needle and a small stone pigment bowl on dark leather; the tattoo glows faintly like it could tear through armour. Show the fist and tools, not a carved plate.
MC-03: Turned waterway: a lagoon channel whose glowing blue-green current has suddenly reversed and runs backwards across the battlefield in curling arcs; distant enemy silhouettes wading in it are swept out of order, the heaviest pushed to the front. The reversed river is the subject; at most a small hand at the edge guides the flow. Show the reversal and the reordered line, not an explosion.
SG3-01: Illusion control: concentric rings of pale moonlight ripple out over a moonlit lagoon from a glowing point on the water; on the far bank one enemy silhouette, small in the distance, has lowered his weapon and drifts toward the light with an illusory shimmer around his head. Mood: hypnotic, quiet, eerie — no explosion.
SG3-02: Water mirage: over a glittering lagoon a heat-haze of water-light bends the air; in the water two reflections are swapped — a hulking brute's reflection is a frail reed-thin shape and a slight one's is a towering giant — while the real figures above are only small dark silhouettes. The mirrored water is the subject. Shimmering, disorienting, no explosion.
NG2-3: Troll regeneration: in a dim forest clearing, green life-glow pours over torn moss and bark; glowing green fibres and tiny sprouting leaves weave a gash closed before our eyes, the wound and its healing filling the frame, with only a hint of grey-green troll hide around it. Warm green life-glow, a few fallen leaves; no fire anywhere (trolls fear fire).
SB1-05: Detonation: across a battlefield, a chain of fiery explosions pops one after another along a line of smouldering embers, each burst flinging sparks and black smoke; the enemy (small dark silhouettes) caught in the flashes. A crude plunger and wire lead in from the frame's edge. Fortan chimneys in the haze behind. Chaotic, loud, joyful.
SG2-01: Vine constrict: a thick thorny vine erupting from forest soil and coiling around an empty suit of heavy steel plate armour, wedging into the seams and squeezing — plates denting and bending, rivets popping. Dim green forest light, moss on the ground; the thicker the armour, the deeper the vine bites.
NG2-1: Burrowing roots: gnarled tree roots bursting up out of the earth and stabbing into the gaps of a row of standing armour pieces (joints, visor slits, shoulder seams), while a plain cloak on the ground among them is left untouched. Crumbling soil, flying clods, dark forest backdrop, cool green light.
MC-14: Armor-crushing entangle: countless vines sweeping across a battlefield, twisting and prying breastplates and helmets apart; loose armour plates sinking into a thick carpet of moss. Wide shot, dim forest, green-grey palette with a few glints of steel; distant figures only as small silhouettes.
SA2-03: Prayer of Silence: a soft dome of pale golden quiet spreads across a battlefield from a glowing circle of light on the ground; inside it the glowing auras and weapon enchantments of the enemy front line (small dark silhouettes) fade out like snuffed candles, drifting up as thin smoke. Still, hushed, gentle light.
NA2-1: Light of Redemption: a column of warm dawn light falls onto the battlefield; inside the beam an enemy's raised weapon slips and falls, its hostile aura dissolving, and where the warrior stood rises a small, calm white-marble saint statue. The beam is the subject; the dark battle behind in silhouette. Soft gold rays.
SA2-07: Scales of Judgment: an enormous golden balance scale hangs in the sky above a battlefield; several glowing sword-shapes bearing the same mark rest together on one pan and dim as it tips, while the enemy below is only a line of small dark silhouettes. Solemn, radiant, ordered composition.
RS-A2-2: Light of Retribution: great spread wings of white light catch a rain of enemy blades; the blocked strikes gather into a bright orb of light above the wings, then lance back as a single spear of radiance at the largest enemy silhouette in the distance. The wings, orb and spear are the subject. Defence turning into counterstrike.
SA2-02: Prayer of Endurance: two shields of light planted at the front of a dark pre-dawn battlefield, small halos glowing on them; each enemy blow that glances off leaves a tiny mote of gold light that drifts up and gathers into a faint growing glow on the eastern horizon behind them. Patient, enduring, the sky just starting to pale.
MA-10: Oath of the Martyr: a fallen sword and a scatter of glowing feathers of light on a grey battlefield, the last radiance of a vanished knight flowing sideways from them into two shield-shaped bubbles of light forming on the left and right. Solemn, sacrificial, warm gold.
MA-14: Release of Dawn: a vast sunrise bursts over a battlefield all at once, a wall of gathered golden dawn light tearing across the horizon; the enemy champions in front (small dark silhouettes) are thrown back blinded, while the leftover light settles gently as warm motes over the allied side. Explosive radiance, long rays, triumphant turn.
IA2-1: Confiscated Obsidian Blade: a jagged black obsidian demon knife, its hilt wrapped in white linen strips marked with faint glowing golden abstract prayer-sigils (illegible, no real letters), lying on a celestial inquisitor's altar cloth; a thin dark red glint still clings to the edge.
SG2-05: Gathering the sap: in a dim forest clearing, glowing amber-green sap streams along the roots of the forest floor from several points into one ancient tree, which swells huge and bursting with life while the spots the sap left grey and withered. Warm sap glow against cool shadow.
SG2-08: Ancient trunk slam: a colossal gnarled trunk crashing down onto a line of small enemy silhouettes; a shockwave of soil, splinters and moss bursting outward, the ground caving in, the bark cracking and drained grey after the blow. The impact is the subject. Low angle, dramatic, dim green forest light.
MG-04: Grudge strike: a huge fist of ochre light, its knuckles wrapped in strips of cloth and bone tokens, rises over the field; faint ochre ghostly shapes of fallen orcs drift into it like smoke, making it heavier as it is about to slam down on a small dark enemy silhouette. Mood: grief turned into fury.
RS-G1-2: Blood oath: at night, drops of blood fall onto a stone war-drum and glow deep red, running together into a single glowing thread that winds along the ground toward the back of the line; only open palms and a bone knife at the edges of the frame. Solemn, tense, a vow before battle; dark crimson and ochre light.
RB1-1: Laying the powder kegs: squat iron-banded powder kegs set into every gap of a broken goblin barricade, each short fuse already lit and sputtering orange sparks; in the background the enemy line (small dark silhouettes) advances, unaware that the kegs face them. Mood: desperate, sly, a fuse-lit pause before the turn of the battle. Show the kegs and fuses, not an explosion.
SB1-08: Blowing the depot: a whole row of powder kegs planted along a barricade goes up at once in a chain of roaring fireballs; the blast throws distant enemy silhouettes back in flames and scorches the barricade itself, splinters and smoke everywhere. Mood: reckless, devastating, a price paid on both sides.
MG-11: Overturned water-mirror: a still lagoon pool whose reflections are upside down and wrong — a shield's reflection is a raised blade, a blade's reflection a shield — while the real figures on the bank are only small dark silhouettes. A ripple of shimmer spreads from a single fingertip touching the surface at the edge. Mood: eerie, mesmerising, quiet; no wave, no explosion.
SA3-06: Archers' Armory: the great wooden doors of the Storm Tower armory swing open on a windy high-elf spire; racks of slender longbows lift off their pegs and fly out on streaks of teal wind, strings glinting, toward small winged silhouettes waiting in the sky. No arrows flying yet — the moment of arming.
NA3-3: Starlight Volley: countless arrows turned into streaks of silver starlight arc high across a night-blue sky and fall like a dense meteor shower over the entire enemy line below (small dark silhouettes); the more bows, the thicker the star-rain, the sky full of light trails. The volley is the subject.
MA-01: Blade of Dread: two thin blades of living shadow slip out of violet smoke past the enemy front (small dark silhouettes) without drawing blood — only cold black wisps and faint whispering shadow-faces curl where they brushed, and the soldiers' weapons sag. Fear, not wounds: no gore, no spilled blood.
PS-A1-2: Plague Shackles: a heavy rusted iron shackle with a blood-wax contract seal clamps shut in the air, chain dragging down; sickly green-violet rot seeps from the iron as creeping mould stains and drifting spores spreading sideways toward distant enemy silhouettes. Corroded chain, a slow contagious dread.
MA-09: Hellfire: a heavy suit of plate armour and a tower shield ignite from within — every plate glows red-hot and bursts into low, hungry violet-and-crimson hellfire, the thicker the plate the fiercer the flame. Black smoke rising, molten rivets dripping; at most a clawed hand closing at the edge of the frame.
CS-A1: Possession of Silence: left, a glowing enemy spell scroll is gagged shut by a ribbon of black smoke and goes dark. Centre, a small, frail translucent ghost-wisp slides into the chest of a huge enemy silhouette, whose outline suddenly thins and buckles. Violet underlight, whisper-thin smoke threads linking the two shapes. No blood.
RS-A1-3: Mind Domination: violet puppet-threads of light descend from the dark sky and hook into the brow of an enemy silhouette marked by a faint curse sigil; its eyes glow violet as it turns its weapon back toward its former comrades. Unsettling calm, closed-eye scales motif faint in the smoke above.
HA1-2: Fingertip Curse: an elegant pale clawed fingertip reaches through shadow smoke and lightly touches the top card of a fanned hand of enemy cards (blank card backs, no text); from that card faint whispering black wisps of fear curl up — dread planted before it ever reaches the field.
HA1-3: Curse Contagion: a fanned hand of enemy cards (blank backs, no text) hovers in darkness; the two front cards are stained by creeping green-violet rot and mould spreading from a single blood-wax sigil, spores drifting toward the neighbouring cards. A slow, sickly infection crawling across the plans of the enemy.
US-A3-1: Contract of the New Moon: under a black new-moon sky above the canyon spires of Noctar, a long black-parchment contract unrolls in mid-air, sealed with blood-red wax and violet sigils, glowing blood ink on it (illegible, no real letters). Beneath it a fanned hand of enemy cards (blank backs) withers and greys like dying leaves, while one fresh card slides from the shadows toward a clawed hand at the edge. Epic: violet light shafts, drifting ash, a faint faceless shadow with balanced scales behind the moon.
RS-A2-1: Light of Judgment: two shields and breastplates laid down at the front of the line release two beams of white-gold radiance that merge into one great descending blade of judgment, striking the first enemy silhouette and piercing on into the one behind. Solemn sacrifice turned into a strike; dawn sky.
PS-A2-1: Atonement in Another's Stead: an enemy blade strikes a shield of light at the front of the line, but the crack appears instead on a second halo-ward just behind it — a thread of golden light links the two, the rear ward absorbing the blow. Sacrificial, tender, warm gold on a grey battlefield.
SG1-01: Driving the Prey: bone horns' echo and a sweep of ochre dust drive the enemy line (small dark silhouettes) like a herd; glowing amber predator eyes in the dust pick out the most wounded, limping silhouettes and herd them to the very front. Dust and the hunt are the subject.
SG2-02: Sprouting Armour: a plate of cracked old bark fills the frame; from every crack fresh green shoots and young leaves burst out, curling over the cracks and knitting them closed as they grow. Mossy forest light, sap glistening, a quiet stubborn renewal rather than a hard shield.
SA3-02: Wind of Confusion: a twisting, disorienting gust spirals across the field and wraps an enemy silhouette; in the whirl its armour plates float outward while a pale heartbeat light sinks inward, the air itself bent and crooked. The spiral of wind is the subject. Storm-grey and silver wind lines, no text.
SA3-05: Wind Recoil: a tight protective whirlwind of silver gusts turns enemy blows aside; from within the cyclone return arrows shoot out and slip straight through the gaps of the attackers' armour (small dark silhouettes). Defensive and counter-striking at once; flying leaves, streaks of wind.
PS-B3-1: Amplifier Circuit: two copper coils with glass tubes and sparking capacitors, thick blue-white lightning surging through their cables toward the front line, where allied weapons and spell-glows (seen small) crackle twice as bright. Brass, copper wire, sparks; ally-boosting, not sabotage.
SG3-03: Veil of Water: a thin, shimmering sheet of seawater rises like a translucent curtain across the field; an enemy blade slices into it and is slowed and dulled, its edge blunted by the flowing water; a soft cleansing ripple washes dark wisps away behind it. The water veil is the subject. No solid shield, no bubble dome — a gentle flowing veil.
MB-05: Ember Scatter: a spray of glowing coals flung from an open sack arcs through the smoky air and settles on the cloaks and straps of distant enemy silhouettes as small hungry flames. Fortan chimneys in the haze; mischievous, not explosive.
NB1-3: Fire Wind: a scorching wind born from Dormak's heart-fire roars across the field, licking flames along banners and cloaks of the distant enemy army (small dark silhouettes) and twisting into a whirling pillar of fire at the very front. Heat haze, blowing sparks and ash. Rare: ember particles and glowing rim light.
